title: The Final Hours
paragraphs: Jesus dropped a bomb on his disciples, saying, 'You know Passover is in two days? That's when I get betrayed and crucified.' At that very moment, the high priests and religious leaders were meeting at the house of Caiaphas the high priest, conspiring to grab Jesus by stealth and kill him. They agreed not to do it during the festival, though — 'We don't want a riot on our hands.'

While Jesus was having dinner at Simon the Leper's house, a woman came in and did something totally extra. She poured a whole bottle of super expensive perfume on him. The disciples lost it, saying, 'What a waste! That could have been sold and the money given to the poor!' But Jesus shut them down, saying, 'Why are you giving her a hard time? She did a beautiful thing for me. You'll always have the poor with you, but you won't always have me. She was preparing me for my burial. I promise you, wherever the good news is preached, what she has done will be told in memory of her.'

That's when Judas, one of the twelve, went full-on snake. He went to the chief priests and asked, 'What will you give me if I hand him over to you?' They offered him thirty pieces of silver, and from then on, he was looking for the right moment to betray Jesus.

On the first day of the Festival of Unleavened Bread, the disciples asked Jesus, 'Where do you want us to get the Passover meal ready?' Jesus said, 'Head into the city and find a certain guy. Tell him, "The Teacher says: My time is almost here — me and my disciples are celebrating Passover at your place."' The disciples followed his instructions to the letter and got the meal ready. That evening, Jesus sat down at the table with the Twelve, and right in the middle of dinner he dropped something heavy on them: 'I have something hard but important to tell you — one of you is going to hand me over to the conspirators.' They were stunned, and one by one they started asking, 'It isn't me, is it, Master?' Jesus answered, 'It's someone I eat with every day — someone who passes me food right here at this table. In one sense, the Son of Man is walking straight into the betrayal the Scriptures already mapped out — no surprises here. But in another sense, the guy who turns traitor on the Son of Man? It would have been better for him if he'd never been born.' Then Judas, already turned traitor, said, 'It isn't me, is it, Rabbi?' Jesus said, 'Don't play games with me, Judas.'

During the meal, Jesus took some bread, blessed it, broke it, and gave it to his disciples. 'Take, eat. This is my body.' Then he took a cup of wine, thanked God for it, and said, 'Drink this, all of you. This is my blood of the new covenant, which is poured out for many for the forgiveness of sins.'

"I'm telling you, I won't drink wine again until the day I drink it with you in My Father's kingdom." Then they sang a hymn and headed out to the Mount of Olives. On the way, Jesus told them, "Tonight, every one of you is going to bail on Me. There's a Scripture that says, \"I'll strike the shepherd, and the sheep will scatter.\" But after I'm raised back to life, I'll go ahead of you to Galilee." Peter shot back, "Even if everyone else bails, I never will!" Jesus said, "I'm telling you the truth — tonight, before the rooster crows, you're going to deny Me three times." Peter insisted, "Even if I have to die with You, I'll never deny You!" And all the other disciples said the exact same thing.

Then Jesus took them to a garden called Gethsemane. 'Stay here while I go over there to pray,' he told the disciples. He took Peter and the two sons of Zebedee with him, and he plunged into the heaviest sorrow imaginable. 'This sorrow is crushing the life out of me,' he said. 'Stay here and keep watch with me.' He went a little further ahead, fell face-down on the ground, and prayed, 'My Father, if there's any way, get me out of this. But please — not what I want. You — what do you want?' When he came back, he found them sound asleep. He said to Peter, 'Seriously? You can't stick it out with me for a single hour? Stay alert and pray, so you don't wander into temptation without even knowing you're in danger. Part of you is totally eager, ready for anything in God — but the other part is as lazy as an old dog sleeping by the fire.' He left them and went to pray a second time: 'My Father, if there's no other way but drinking this cup down to the last drop, I'm ready. Do it your way.' When he came back, they were asleep again — they just couldn't keep their eyes open. This time he let them sleep and went back a third time to pray, going over the same ground one last time. Then he came back and said, 'Are you really going to sleep on and make a night of it? My time is up — the Son of Man is about to be handed over to sinners. Get up! Let's go! Here comes my betrayer.'

The words were barely out of his mouth when Judas — one of the Twelve — showed up with a gang sent by the high priests and religious leaders, all armed with swords and clubs. The betrayer had worked out a signal with them: 'The one I kiss, that's the one — grab him.' He went straight up to Jesus, said, 'How are you, Rabbi?' and kissed him. Jesus said, 'Friend, why this charade?' Then they grabbed Jesus and roughed him up. One of the guys with Jesus pulled out his sword and took a swing at the high priest's servant, cutting off his ear. Jesus said, 'Put your sword back where it belongs. Everyone who uses swords gets destroyed by swords. Don't you realize I could call out to my Father right now and he'd send twelve companies of battle-ready angels — more if I wanted? But if I did that, how would the Scriptures come true that say this is the way it has to happen?' Then Jesus turned to the mob: 'What's with the swords and clubs, like I'm some dangerous criminal? Day after day I've been sitting in the Temple teaching, and you never lifted a finger against me. But this is how it's going down, to make the prophetic writings come true.' Then all the disciples cut and ran.

They took Jesus to the high priest, Caiaphas, for a sham trial. They brought in a bunch of liars to testify against him, but their stories were all over the place. Finally, two came forward and said, 'This fellow said, 'I am able to destroy the temple of God and rebuild it in three days.'' The high priest stood up and asked Jesus, 'Have you no answer?' But Jesus stayed silent. So the high priest said, 'I charge you under oath by the living God: Tell us if you are the Messiah, the Son of God.' Jesus replied, 'You have said so. But I say to all of you: From now on you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of the Mighty One and coming on the clouds of heaven.' The high priest lost it, tore his clothes, and yelled, 'Blasphemy!' The whole council condemned him to death. Then they started spitting in his face and knocking him around, jeering as they slapped him: 'Prophesy, Messiah! Who hit you that time?' All this time, Peter had followed at a safe distance to the high priest's courtyard, slipped in, and blended with the servants to watch how it would all turn out.

Meanwhile, Peter was outside in the courtyard, and a servant girl came up to him and said, 'You also were with Jesus of Galilee.' But he denied it, saying, 'I don't know what you're talking about.' He went out to the gateway, where someone else spotted him and told the people there, 'This fellow was with Jesus of Nazareth.' He denied it again, with an oath: 'I don't know the man!' A little later, the bystanders said to Peter, 'Surely you are one of them; your accent gives you away.' Then he began to call down curses, and he swore to them, 'I don't know the man!' Immediately a rooster crowed, and Peter remembered what Jesus had said: 'Before the rooster crows, you will disown me three times.' And he went outside and wept bitterly.

splits.note: MSG 26-29(떡과 잔) 문단이 EN4(26-28절, 성찬 제정)와 EN5(29절, 포도주 서원)로 나뉨

changes: P0(1-5): MSG 원문의 인명 '가야바(Caiaphas)' 복원 — 기존 EN에 빠져 있었음. '축제 기간에는 하지 않기로 합의' 내용도 복원
P1(6-13): 'on his head' → 'on him' (MSG는 부위 미지정, 13절 'poured this perfume on my body')

P3(17-25): MSG 17-19(유월절 준비 지시 — '어느 사람에게 가서...') 전면 복원 — 기존 EN에 통째 빠져 있었음. MSG 23-24의 '배신은 성경에 기록된 대로 / 배신자에게는 차라리 태어나지 않았더라면' 경고 복원. MSG 25 예수 대답을 'You said it'에서 MSG 원문 'Don't play games with me, Judas.'로 정정
P4(26-28): stray '>' 마크다운 인용 부호 2곳 제거
P6(36-46): 겟세마네 대폭 복원 — 베드로와 세베대 두 아들 동행, '이 슬픔이 내 생명을 짓누른다', 얼굴을 땅에 대고 기도, '시험에 들지 않도록 깨어 기도하라 / eager한 부분과 old dog처럼 게으른 부분', 두 번째 기도('잔을 바닥까지 마셔야 한다면'), 세 번째 기도 반복
P7(47-56): 복원 — 'Friend, why this charade?', '칼을 쓰는 자는 칼로 망한다', '열두 군단 천사' 뒤의 '성경이 어떻게 이루어지겠느냐', 무리를 향한 연설('위험한 범죄자처럼... 날마다 성전에서 가르쳤는데... 예언의 기록을 이루려')
P8(57-68): 복원 — 베드로가 멀찍이 따라와 뜰에 숨어 지켜봄, 'Prophesy, Messiah! Who hit you that time?' 조롱
